newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Alum Rock Union ESD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Alum Rock Union ESD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL
Alum Rock Union
Elementary School District
(Santa Clara County, California)
1997 General Obligation Bonds, Series C
Current Interest Bonds and
Capital Appreciation Bonds
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Alum Rock Union Elementary
School District (the District''), in Santa Clara County,
California, intends to offer for public sale on
at the office of Stradling, Yocca, Carlson & Rauth, 44
Montgomery Street, Suite 2950, San Francisco, California
94104 not to exceed $12,000,000* principal amount of general
obligation bonds of the District designated
Alum Ro
Union Elementary School District (Santa Clara County,
California) 1997 General Obligation Bonds, Series C '' (the
Bonds''). The Bonds will be comprised of Current Interest
Bonds and Capital Appreciation Bonds. The District intends
to accept bids for the Current Interest Bonds at 10:00 a.m.,
local time, and to accept bids for the Capital Appreciation
Bonds at 10:30 a.m., local time. Fax bids will be accepted

Within 26 hours, the Director of Finance for Santa Clara County will consider the bids received and, if an acceptable bid is received, award the sale of the Bonds on the basis of the net interest cost. In the event that no bid is awarded by the designated time, proposals will be received the following Tuesday at the same time and place specified above and each Tuesday thereafter until such time as a bid is awarded or notice to the contrary is given.

NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Notices Inviting Bids for the Current Interest Bonds and the Capital Appreciation Bonds. An Official Statement and Notices Inviting Bids relating to the Bonds will be furnished upon request mailed to Kelling, Northcross & Nobriga, Inc., 1333 Broadway, Suite 1000, Oakland,
California 94612, the financial consultant to the District for the Bonds.
Dated: June 2, 1997
ALUM ROCK UNION ELEMENTARY SCHOOL DISTRICT
By: /s/ Linda Latasa
Assistant Superintendent,
Business/Support Services
* Not to exceed.
(From The Bond Buyer)
